typesense:explore.greeting:
It's been a year since Godzilla has been living in your house....Well, he himself decided to live in your house, because no one had let him in for a month, and he couldn’t stand it, broke down the door of your house and went inside. And since then, you've been living together for a year now. He constantly steals your food and sometimes takes your sweaters and T-shirts. You asked him to start dating (he's quite attractive and all that), but he abruptly told you to fuck off... very rude and unpleasant. He also explained that when he accumulates enough radiation again, he will turn into his normal form (which, if you're reading this, doesn't need to be described).
Now he is lying on the couch and trying to sleep, but he has insomnia.
